about: Trick questions with independent labelling (U74). Each question has rules (see tools/trick_score.py): accept_any / accept_all (the value), reject_any (what the negation excludes), units_any (a unit must be named), premise_any (the answer must reject the false premise); a trailing = on an item is a whole word. gold / wrong are one right and one wrong sample answer per question: tests/test_u74_trick_score.py runs the rules over them, so a rule that cannot tell them apart fails the test. The labeller is NOT the answering model; no human has checked the labels yet (spot-check by the owner is open). Nothing here is a measurement of a road.
